description.zh: tr 翻译、dict AI 词典：用本机的本地模型离线翻译，或用自己密钥的 DeepL、微软翻译及 OpenAI 兼容模型服务
description.en: tr translation and dict AI dictionary: offline with a local model on this computer, or with your own DeepL, Microsoft Translator or OpenAI-compatible service key

notes.zh: 新增服务“本地模型（离线）”：装了“本地模型”插件后，翻译在这台电脑上完成，不用密钥；没装、没下载模型或模型停了时，结果行会说明，回车打开它的卡片。Ollama、LM Studio 这类本机服务选“OpenAI 兼容”、地址填 127.0.0.1 即可，不走系统代理。在搜索框里用模型服务翻译时，结果边出边显示。权限不变。
notes.en: New service Local model (offline): with the Local models plugin installed, translation happens on this PC with no key; when it is missing, has no model or has stopped, the row says so and Enter opens its card. Ollama, LM Studio and the like work as OpenAI-compatible on 127.0.0.1, never through the system proxy. In the search box a model service shows the translation as it comes. Permissions unchanged.
